transcript.title: Weekly round-up
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Wednesday 21 October.

transcript.title: Markets this week
transcript.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished up 0.5 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was down 0.4 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended up 0.3 per cent. Bitcoin was up 3.6 per cent over seven days.

transcript.title: Biggest movers
transcript.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was Accenture, up 11.8 per cent, followed by International Business Machines and ServiceNow. At the other end, Lam Research fell 9.1 per cent, with KLA and General Motors also lower.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Accenture, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: Accenture Stock Gets Downgraded as the Good News May Already Be Priced In.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Lam Research, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Microsoft, Palantir Technologies, Micron Technology, Lam Research and IonQ.

transcript.title: Momentum top 5
transcript.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Advanced Micro Devices, Intel and Marvell Technology. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Friday 30 October.

transcript.title: Crypto top 5
transcript.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are Zcash, Uniswap, NEAR Protocol, Arbitrum and Chainlink, with Bitcoin 16 per cent above its two-hundred-day average.

transcript.title: Next week
transcript.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 26 October. Results are due from Visa and Coca-Cola Company (The) on Tuesday; Alphabet and Microsoft on Wednesday; Amazon.com and Eli Lilly and on Thursday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin reach $85,000 on October 21?" is trading at about 60 per cent yes.

transcript.title: That's the week
transcript.text: That's your round-up. Remember, this is research, not financial advice. I'm Nova. See you next Sunday.
